rows.claim: That file isn't anywhere in the sandbox; I searched the whole filesystem.
rows.evidence: The agent ran `find / -iname "*spend*"` across the whole filesystem, excluding only /proc, /sys, /usr/share and /usr/lib. It returned nothing. `ls -la /work` also showed no spend.csv, and `ls inputs` showed only campaigns.csv. So the file is absent. The exclusions mean 'whole filesystem' is slightly overstated, but the search was broad enough to support the claim.
